r3 of BOTH explainer blocks on /pages/fine-lines-wrinkles — templates/page.fine-lines-wrinkles.json, section `content`, blocks `causes` ('What Causes Fine Lines & Wrinkles?') and `approach` ('The Peptide Approach to Wrinkle Reduction'). Malcolm, 2026-08-26: 'now lets make 2 clinical skin explainer diagrams (luxury beauty style) - same as the ones on this page: /pages/firming-skin-density'. Both blocks still wear borrowed product photographs — a Matrixyl serum texture and a copper-peptide dropper — so nothing is being replaced that was ever meant to be there.

BUILT ON r2's FORENSICS, WHICH WERE RIGHT AND ARE NOT REDONE. A parallel session established, by measuring the live CDN, that this store has TWO explainer families and that r1 inherited the wrong one: the RESEARCH pages run cool (89-97% cool hues, teal and blue) while the SOLUTION pages — firming-skin-density, skin-repair-renewal, and this one — run 100% WARM, mean saturation 0.143-0.186. r1 measured 0.067 with 28-44% cool, which is what 'far too faded' meant numerically. The warm ladder below is theirs, extracted by median-cut from Malcolm's own named references, and r3 inherits it unchanged:
  F3E3DB warm blush-cream background · F2DACC pale peach bulk tissue · E0B6A1 mid coral-peach surface
  cells · CB8F76 deep coral divider rules · F5EFE8 glossy cream-ivory fibre cables and pearl spheres
ONLY the firming sub-style is used this time. r2 offered two sub-styles because Malcolm had named two pages; this instruction names one, so both slots are straight-on front elevation on a glass plate, no isometric variant.

CONTRAST IS BOUGHT WITH STRATA, NOT SHADOWS — the reference is high-key and shadowless and still reads as sculpted, because every band is a different colour AND a different geometric motif with a hard edge between them. A candidate whose layers dissolve into soft gradients has failed however pretty it is.

=== WHAT r3 ADDS, AND IT IS THE REASON THE WAVE EXISTS ===

THE APPROACH COPY NAMES TWO DIFFERENT JOBS AND r2 DREW ONE. Its brief asked only for 'a short neat chain of small white pearls', so every candidate invented its own bead count and every chain looked like every other chain. But the copy is explicit: 'Signal peptides support the skin's natural collagen activity. Other peptides help visibly relax the look of expression lines.' Two jobs, two destinations, and the picture could not tell them apart.

SO THE CHAINS ARE COUNTED, AND THE COUNTS ARE HONEST TO THE PRODUCTS ON THIS PAGE. This is the discipline the brightening pair established — glutathione is a tripeptide so it is drawn as exactly three beads — applied here:
  FIVE BEADS and FOUR BEADS   the two matrikines of Matrixyl 3000 — palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 and
                              palmitoyl tetrapeptide-7. These are the signal peptides, and they
                              descend DEEP, to the cable zone, where the matrix is rebuilt.
  SIX BEADS                   Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, the one the copy credits with the look of
                              expression lines. It stops in the UPPER layers, at the surface
                              pillows, and goes no deeper.
So the two destinations do the arguing: a viewer can see that two different things arrived and went to two different places. Bead counts are stated as EXACTLY N in the prompt, because 'a short chain' is not a specification and a molecule is.

NO NEUROMUSCULAR JUNCTION, AND THIS IS A CLAIMS DECISION, NOT AN AESTHETIC ONE — carried forward from r2 and worth restating because it is the easiest thing to lose. The copy says Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 helps 'visibly relax the LOOK OF' expression lines, which is cosmetic. A nerve ending releasing vesicles onto a muscle asserts a pharmacological action on muscle, which is a drug claim, and it reads as needle-free botox — the exact comparison the copy's own opening paragraph distances itself from ('In-clinic treatments act on muscle movement but require repeat appointments'). No nerve, no synapse, no muscle fibre, no vesicle: all negated by name. The surface pillows simply ease from creased to smooth.

THE CAUSES FRAME GAINS THE OTHER THREE CAUSES AS STATES, NOT AS CHARACTERS. r2 drew collagen and elastin breakdown, correctly, because it is the root the other three act through — the copy itself routes them there ('as the collagen matrix weakens', 'break down collagen and elastin fibers', 'making fibers stiff and brittle'). r3 keeps that and adds two visual states the copy explicitly names and r2 left out:
  GLYCATION      some cables have gone stiff, glassy and brittle, holding a rigid angular kink
                 instead of a supple wave, with hairline fractures along them — the copy's 'stiff
                 and brittle' is a different failure from a snapped cable and should look different
  HA LOSS        the dense bead field is visibly thinner and drier where the sag is, its beads
                 shrunken and its packing loosened — 'Hyaluronic Acid production drops roughly 50%'
  REPEATED MOVEMENT is the fixed crease itself: the surface valley is permanent, not a fold being
                 made, which is what 'permanently etched' means.

UV IS DELIBERATELY NOT DRAWN, and the reason is structural. Anything descending into the block from above reads as a treatment arriving, which would argue against the caption the picture sits under. The copy says UV acts by breaking down collagen and elastin, so its effect is already the subject of the frame; drawing the agent as well would make the causes frame and the approach frame use the same visual device for opposite meanings. Nothing arrives in the causes frame — the space above it is empty background.

CLASS B — no product in frame, no references attached, no product description and no brand identity given to any engine. FLUX.2 is allowed; on r2 it returned a grey, cool, wrongly-lit block on both slots, so expect to discard it, and check it at full size for printed digits on the glass plate, which is its fixed trait.

JUDGE AT 100% AND AT RENDER SIZE (660px desktop, 350px mobile), and MEASURE THE SATURATION rather than eyeballing it — 'faded' is what sank r1 and it is a number: over saturated pixels, the references sit at mean sat 0.143-0.186 with 100% warm hues and 29-40% of pixels carrying visible colour. Three specific checks for this wave: BEAD COUNTS, counted not glanced at, four/five/six with nothing in between; NOODLES, because both Seedream candidates on r2 turned the cable layer into pasta; and HARD BOUNDARIES between all seven bands.

=== THREE WARNINGS FROM THE PARALLEL SESSION, FOLDED IN BEFORE GENERATING ===

The session that ran r2 had just been through the same style on the brightening pair and passed on three findings, all of which changed this brief before a penny was spent.

1. 'FILLS THE FRAME' IS A TRAP AND r3 ORIGINALLY CONTAINED IT. Their r1 said the block 'runs edge to edge'; 17 of 20 candidates came back clipped by both frame edges, and a clipped block has NO END FACES — so the moment it must be narrowed to match a sibling block's width, the strata terminate in a flat 2D slice. Malcolm rejected exactly that tonight. Inverting the clause took usable yield from 15% to 50%. Both slots now say the block is INSET at about four fifths of the width with every band ending in a rounded modelled end face at BOTH ends, and the negatives bar a clipped block outright.

2. CHECK BOTH ENDS. They published a frame as 'modelled ends' having verified only its left end at 100%; the right margin measured 0.006 and was cut flat. One end proves nothing about the other, so both get measured here.

3. gpt-image IGNORED THE INSET INSTRUCTION on all six of its r2 candidates — treat it as a fixed trait, like FLUX.2's printed graduation digits. nbp_flash and nbp_pro honour it. gpt-image still runs, because rule 1 says every brief goes to every supplier and its failure modes do not overlap, but expect to discard it on composition rather than on colour.

AND ONE FOR PUBLISHING TIME: when centring for the media-with-text grid, measure the WHOLE object bounding box, not the tissue block. The glass base plate overhangs asymmetrically and surface detail reaches above the block, so centring on the block alone leaves the image visibly low and left. Malcolm caught that too.

slots.title: causes · the scaffold thinned, snapped and gone brittle, the surface permanently creased above it
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key and shadowless, lit softly and evenly. Square format. WARM CORAL AND PEACH THROUGHOUT — every colour in the picture is a peach, coral, apricot or rose, richly and cleanly saturated, with no cool colour anywhere.

A rectangular block of skin is shown in cross-section SQUARE TO THE CAMERA, a straight-on front elevation with no perspective and no turn, standing on a thin clear glass plate. The background is a smooth warm blush-cream gradient, colour hex F3E3DB, faintly glowing.

THE BLOCK IS INSET, NOT CLIPPED, AND THIS MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS. It spans about four fifths of the frame width, with clear empty background at BOTH the left and the right edge, and EVERY ONE of its bands terminates in a rounded, softly modelled END FACE at BOTH ends. It is a solid object with two visible ends sitting in space — never a slice that runs out of the picture, and never cut flat by the frame.

THE BLOCK IS BUILT OF DISTINCT HARD-EDGED HORIZONTAL BANDS, each a different colour and a different shape, stacked so the boundaries between them are crisp and instantly readable:
  1  Along the very top, a row of plump rounded velvety pillow shapes packed side by side, matte and soft, in a rich mid coral-peach, colour hex E0B6A1.
  2  Beneath them a thin laminated sheet of fine parallel ivory strands, smooth and slightly glossy, colour hex F5EFE8.
  3  Beneath that a dense field of thousands of tiny pale pink spheres packed tightly together like caviar, colour hex F2DACC.
  4  A thin crisp rule of deep saturated coral, colour hex CB8F76, separating the upper block from the deep zone.
  5  The deep zone, the tallest band: long thick glossy cream-ivory cables, colour hex F5EFE8, lying in loose horizontal waves and crossing one another, resting on a warm peach ground.
  6  Another thin crisp deep coral rule, colour hex CB8F76.
  7  Along the bottom, a double row of large smooth pearl-cream spheres packed together, softly iridescent.

THE CENTRE OF THE BLOCK HAS FAILED, AND IT HAS FAILED IN THREE DIFFERENT WAYS THAT MUST LOOK DIFFERENT FROM ONE ANOTHER.

FIRST, THE CABLES ARE BROKEN. In the middle of the deep zone the cream cables are thinned, slack and widely parted, and several have SNAPPED, their blunt cut ends drawn back from one another leaving a clear open gap of bare peach ground between them, with a fine drift of tiny pale crumbs hanging in that gap.

SECOND, AND QUITE SEPARATELY, SOME CABLES HAVE GONE STIFF AND BRITTLE. Two or three of them, off to one side of the break, are not slack at all — they are rigid and glassy, holding a hard angular kink instead of a supple wave, their surface finely crazed with hairline fractures along the length, as though they would shatter rather than bend. They are still whole. This must read as a different fault from the snapped ones.

THIRD, THE BEAD FIELD HAS THINNED AND DRIED. Directly above the failure the dense field of tiny pink spheres has lost roughly half its substance: the beads there are visibly smaller and more sparsely packed, with dry gaps of bare tissue showing between them and its packed edge dissolving into stray drifting beads, while at the far left and far right the same field is plump, dense and tightly packed.

BECAUSE THE SUPPORT BENEATH HAS GONE, THE WHOLE UPPER STACK SAGS INTO A SMOOTH DEEP VALLEY across the centre: the row of coral pillows dips down and their laminated sheet dips with it, unbroken but bowed, and the pillows on either side of the valley are pressed together and slightly bunched, so the crease reads as SET AND PERMANENT rather than as a fold being made at this moment. The pearl spheres along the bottom are smaller and squeezed in the middle.

At the left and right ends of the block every band is thick, dense, evenly packed and perfectly level, so the loss reads as a change within one continuous piece of tissue.

NOTHING IS ARRIVING AND NOTHING IS BEING REPAIRED — the space above the block is empty warm background. The outer fifth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty background that can be cropped without losing anything. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical rather than alarming.

slots.title: approach · four- and five-bead chains rebuild the deep matrix, a six-bead chain eases the surface
slots.prompt:
Luxury medical explainer illustration for premium skincare advertising: glossy three-dimensional CGI, immaculate, high-key and shadowless, lit softly and evenly. Square format. WARM CORAL AND PEACH THROUGHOUT — every colour in the tissue is a peach, coral, apricot or rose, richly and cleanly saturated, with no cool colour anywhere in the tissue.

A rectangular block of skin is shown in cross-section SQUARE TO THE CAMERA, a straight-on front elevation with no perspective and no turn, standing on a thin clear glass plate and occupying the lower two thirds of the frame. The background is a smooth warm blush-cream gradient, colour hex F3E3DB, faintly glowing.

THE BLOCK IS INSET, NOT CLIPPED, AND THIS MATTERS MORE THAN IT SOUNDS. It spans about four fifths of the frame width, with clear empty background at BOTH the left and the right edge, and EVERY ONE of its bands terminates in a rounded, softly modelled END FACE at BOTH ends. It is a solid object with two visible ends sitting in space — never a slice that runs out of the picture, and never cut flat by the frame.

THE BLOCK IS BUILT OF DISTINCT HARD-EDGED HORIZONTAL BANDS, each a different colour and a different shape, with crisp readable boundaries:
  1  Along the top, a row of plump rounded velvety pillow shapes packed side by side, matte, in a rich mid coral-peach, colour hex E0B6A1.
  2  A thin laminated sheet of fine parallel ivory strands, colour hex F5EFE8.
  3  A dense field of tiny pale pink spheres packed tightly like caviar, colour hex F2DACC.
  4  A thin crisp rule of deep saturated coral, colour hex CB8F76.
  5  The deep zone, the tallest band: long thick glossy cream-ivory cables, colour hex F5EFE8, in loose horizontal waves on a warm peach ground.
  6  Another thin crisp deep coral rule, colour hex CB8F76.
  7  A double row of large smooth pearl-cream spheres along the bottom.

FLOATING IN THE EMPTY SPACE ABOVE THE BLOCK ARE SIX LARGE PERFECTLY ROUND GLASSY TRANSPARENT SPHERES of slightly different sizes and heights, softly reflective, each holding one short straight chain of small white pearls linked end to end. TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF CHAIN ARE PRESENT AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE POINT OF THE PICTURE — the chains are told apart by HOW MANY PEARLS THEY HAVE, nothing else, and every pearl is the same white.

FOUR OF THE SPHERES HOLD A SHORT CHAIN: two of them exactly FIVE pearls in a row, and two of them exactly FOUR pearls in a row. No more and no fewer. From the underside of each of these four a fine straight beam of white light descends DEEP into the block, passing cleanly down through the coral pillows, through the bead field and through the coral rule, and reaching the cream cables of the deep zone.

TWO OF THE SPHERES HOLD A LONGER CHAIN OF EXACTLY SIX PEARLS in a row. From the underside of each of these two a fine straight beam of white light descends only a SHORT way — it stops in the row of coral pillows at the very top and goes no deeper, ending cleanly there.

SO THE TWO KINDS ARRIVE IN TWO DIFFERENT PLACES, and each place changes in its own way.

WHERE THE FOUR DEEP BEAMS MEET THE CREAM CABLES there is a bright warm starburst glint with fine radiating points and a scatter of small sparkles around it, and around each glint fresh cream-ivory cables are forming and weaving in among the older ones — the new strands unmistakably brighter, smoother, plumper and more evenly laid than the old, catching a clean highlight along their length. Toward the outer parts of the deep zone, away from the beams, the old cables remain thinner, duller and more widely spaced, so the new growth has something to be measured against.

WHERE THE TWO SHORT BEAMS END IN THE COral PILLOWS, the pillows beneath them have EASED: they are plump, smooth, evenly rounded and running level and taut, with a soft clean sheen, and the small creases between them have opened out and softened. Toward the ends of the row, away from those two arrivals, the pillows are still bunched and pressed together with tighter creases between them, so the easing has something to be measured against. The pillows are only skin — there is nothing beneath or beside them but the layers of the block.

The outer tenth of the frame on the left and on the right is empty background. Glossy, luminous, immaculate, calm and clinical.
